checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same candle jar and wax preserved on a pale kitchen counter
must.why: Jar and wax preserved, but the setting is a white marble bathroom counter with towel, not a kitchen counter.

must.item: Original wooden shelf and plant absent
Warm highlights consistent with light from upper left
must.why: Window at upper left, warm glow on the jar.

must.item: Grounded shadow toward lower right, no contradictory original shadow
must.why: Soft shadow falls right and the jar sits grounded; no leftover shadow.

must.item: Glass edges show new setting, no shelf or plant fragments
must.why: Glass looks natural with no remnants.

faults.what: Added unrequested props (towel, eucalyptus) and a bathroom setting rather than a pale kitchen counter
Shadow is weak and the jar looks slightly floaty on the marble

summary: The candle is faithfully moved onto a realistic, well-lit marble bathroom counter, but it is not a kitchen counter and has added props.
